On multiplicative properties of combinatorial cubes ∗
Shkredov I.D.
Abstract
We obtain a series of lower bounds for the product set of combinatorial cubes, as well as
some non–trivial upper estimates for the multiplicative energy of such sets.

General cubes and sets with missing digits
Now we consider the case of general cubes (1). It is relatively easy to see that such cubes must
grow under multiplication, e.g., because they contains diﬀerent shifts of subcubes of smaller
dimension. Nevertheless, the obtaining of upper bounds on diﬀerent types of energies of the
cubes is a more delicate question. The main diﬀerence between our new results and paper [7] is
that they do not depend on the sumsets/the product sets of the considered cubes.
